raw_text: An AI-generated audio clip mimicking India's Defence Minister discussing classified troop movements has been confirmed as fabricated by the Ministry of Defence. The clip, which first surfaced on Telegram channels, was analysed by multiple audio forensics experts who identified synthetic artifacts including uniform pitch modulation, absent breathing patterns, and spectral characteristics consistent with AI voice cloning technology.
clean_text: AI-generated audio clip mimicking Defence Minister confirmed fabricated by MoD. Multiple forensics experts identified synthetic artifacts including uniform pitch and AI voice cloning characteristics.
